title: notification.delivered.v1
description: Proof that one party was (or could not be) notified about an incident. Producer: notification-service. Consumers: audit-proof-service (dossier: 'customer notified at T via email, provider ref X'), ops console. Wrapped in _envelope.v1.json; correlation_id is the incident, causation_id is the event that triggered the notification. Exchange notification.x, routing key notification.delivered.v1.

source_event_id.description: event_id of the containment/rescue/evasion event that was notified

recipient.description: email, phone, or a logical name such as 'ops'. PII: the audit service decides retention.

status.description: FAILED is terminal (permanent provider rejection or no contact details); transient failures are retried and never emitted.

provider.description: e.g. slack, resend; absent on FAILED before a provider was reached

provider_ref.description: provider message id, for tracing a delivery with the provider

sent_at.description: when the terminal status was reached
